maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from MSO services, medical supplies and franchise-type support to aesthetic clinics, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Mainly self-pay aesthetic medicine (cosmetic surgery, dermatology) paid by consumers, not government insurance.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by opening and supporting its own clinic network and selling services to affiliated clinics, not a steady acquisition roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Affiliated clinics depend on its management, marketing, systems and supply support; switching away would be disruptive.

notes: Judged from general knowledge: most revenue comes from SBC-affiliated aesthetic clinics in Japan, which are largely self-pay.
